import.title: Import trades
import.statementTimezoneHelp: Choose the timezone used by your broker's statement. Timestamps with an explicit offset keep that offset. Your journal displays times in {displayZone}.
import.invalidTimezone: Enter a valid IANA timezone, such as Europe/Helsinki.
import.pdfNeedsAi: Enable AI parsing to upload a PDF statement.
import.aiTooLarge: AI uploads must be 8 MB or smaller.
import.aiBadType: Choose a CSV, TSV, HTML, XML, TXT or PDF file. Export spreadsheets as CSV first.
import.aiTextTooLarge: Use a smaller export: AI text parsing supports up to 150,000 characters.
import.dropzoneAi: Choose a statement for AI parsing
import.dropzone: Choose a CSV / HTML / XML statement
import.dropzoneAiHint: CSV, TSV, HTML, XML, TXT or PDF. Your file stays local until you preview with AI.
import.autoDetect: Auto-detected: {formats} — anything else via column mapping.
import.needsMapping: Format not recognized — map your columns (nothing is guessed silently):
import.positionHelp: For Open/Close Long/Short rows, map source position IDs, execution IDs or sequence numbers when available. Columns named Position ID, Execution ID, Fill ID and Sequence are recognized automatically. An order ID is not an execution ID.
import.skippedRowsCount: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
import.ninjaHint: Recovering an older NinjaTrader import or correcting its timezone? Import the complete history into a new journal account, then compare totals. Keep the original account and its reviews until you have verified the recovery.
import.correctHint: Correcting a previous import? Remove the affected trades before importing again with a different timezone to avoid duplicates. Back up your data first.
import.aiReviewLabel: I compared all extracted executions with my statement, including the account, quantities, prices, fees and timestamps. Import this preview.
import.commitSummary: Imported {inserted, plural, one {# execution} other {# executions}} ({duplicates, plural, one {# duplicate skipped} other {# duplicates skipped}}, {corrected, plural, one {# fee correction} other {# fee corrections}}).
import.commitSkipped: {count, plural, one {# invalid row was skipped} other {# invalid rows were skipped}}: {reasons}

ai.help: If you're having issues importing a file, AI parsing can help. The journal supports many broker exports, but column names and statement layouts can change. OpenAI or Anthropic can interpret unfamiliar formats and extract trades for your review. Check quantities, prices, fees and dates against your statement before importing. Your file is sent to your chosen provider using your API key; provider usage charges apply.
ai.keyConfiguredPlaceholder: Leave blank to use your configured key
ai.sessionKeyNote: Keys entered here are used for this upload session only. Manage saved keys in Settings.
ai.sendNotice: Your file will be sent to {provider} when you select Preview with AI. Provider charges apply. Review the extracted trades before importing.
ai.limits: CSV, TSV, HTML, XML, TXT and PDF · Up to 200 executions per preview. PDFs up to 8 MB; text exports up to 150,000 characters. For spreadsheets, export as CSV first. PDF support depends on your selected model.

review.title: Review NinjaTrader import
review.intro: Keep each source account separate inside your selected journal account. Review the result before saving.
review.chooseSource: Choose the source this file belongs to
review.sourceHelp: If an account or connection was renamed, select its existing source. Choose a new source only for a genuinely different account.
review.newFills: {count, plural, one {# new fill} other {# new fills}}
review.duplicateFills: {count, plural, one {# duplicate fill} other {# duplicate fills}}
review.feeCorrections: {count, plural, one {# fee correction} other {# fee corrections}}
review.tradeCounts: {closed, plural, one {# closed trade} other {# closed trades}} · {open, plural, one {# open trade} other {# open trades}}
review.completeHistoryLabel: This export includes every execution for each listed source contract between its first and last timestamp. It is not a partial selection of repeated fills.
review.approveCorrectionsLabel: Apply these commission corrections to the existing executions and recalculate P&L.
review.reviewDone: Review complete. Import will save this result; if the file, settings or journal changes, another review is required.

conflicts.skippedInvalidRows: {count, plural, one {# invalid execution row was skipped.} other {# invalid execution rows were skipped.}} Correct the export before importing, so positions are not reconstructed from incomplete fills.
conflicts.savedMappingLocked: {label}: a saved source mapping cannot be reassigned. Use another destination account for a different source.
conflicts.selectSource: {label}: select a source belonging to this destination account.
conflicts.chooseSource: {label}: choose its saved source account, or explicitly create a new source.
conflicts.legacyFills: This account contains matching legacy fills without reliable source identity. Recover the complete export into a new journal account; the old account and annotations will remain unchanged.
conflicts.contradictoryExecutionId: One execution ID has contradictory values within this export. Correct the file before importing.
conflicts.differentTimezone: This source has earlier imports using a different statement timezone. Use the original timezone or recover the corrected complete history into a new journal account.
conflicts.mixedIdLayouts: Matching fills use different execution-ID layouts. Keep the ID columns consistent or reconcile the complete history in a new journal account.
conflicts.changedExecutionId: {symbol}: an existing execution ID has changed quantity, price, side, instrument, time or ordering facts. Reconcile it separately; it will not be inserted again.
conflicts.feesChangedWithoutIds: Fees changed on fills without execution IDs. Reconcile the complete history separately; occurrence numbers cannot reliably identify corrected fills.
conflicts.overlapNeedsCompleteHistory: This export overlaps earlier fills without execution IDs. Confirm it includes every execution for these source contracts between its first and last timestamp, or supply a complete export.
conflicts.incompleteCompleteExport: The declared complete export omits or changes previously imported fills in its covered period. Reconcile the difference or recover into a new journal account; nothing will be removed automatically.
conflicts.multiplierRequired: Set a positive contract multiplier for {symbol} in Settings, then review this import again.
conflicts.wouldReplaceIdentities: This import would replace existing trade identities and could orphan reviews or attachments. Recover the complete history into a new journal account instead.
conflicts.ambiguousOrder: {symbol} at {time}: execution order is ambiguous or contradicts Entry/Exit. Export more precise timestamps, a reliable Sequence column, and the missing earlier fills. No row order was guessed.

reviewWarnings.noExecutionIds: Without execution IDs, identical-looking new fills cannot be distinguished from an exact repeated export. Complete exports retain their full counts; ambiguous partial overlaps require reconciliation.
reviewWarnings.missingFees: {count, plural, one {# row omits commission.} other {# rows omit commission.}} The preview uses your configured default fees, or zero when none are configured.

broker.title: Connect a broker (read-only keys, stored encrypted on YOUR machine)
broker.skippedRecords: {count, plural, one {# broker record was skipped} other {# broker records were skipped}}: {reasons}
broker.tzLoadFailed: Could not load the import timezone. Refresh and try again.
broker.tzInfo: Statement timezone: {zone}. Used for Flex timestamps without an offset. Change it in Settings → Journal before connecting.
